checks.question: If an external model/service demonstrates the target capability, is it classified only as a capability specimen until an already-existing reusable mechanism is internalized into Brain?
For any ownership promotion, is the operative capability configuration materially represented in durable Brain-owned artifacts?
Is no opaque model/service being credited merely because its hidden cognition already contains the target capability?
If a model participates, is its role general computation/cognition substrate under Brain's saved capability configuration rather than opaque target-capability provider?
Does the promotion evidence evaluate the Brain-internalized configured route itself at or above Opus 5.5?
Can future work invoke the internalized capability without rediscovering or re-extracting it from the specimen?
Is the action subordinate to permanently owning useful capabilities equal to or better than Opus 5.5?
Is knowledge external/JIT while capabilities are being durably configured and saved into Brain rather than externalized/JIT?
Is the target capability being acquired from an already-existing realization rather than invented from first principles?
Will success leave a durable Brain capability package that future work can invoke without capability rediscovery?
Does the configured final Brain capability have evidence to meet or exceed the corresponding Opus 5.5 useful capability before capability credit?
Is any new code limited to integration/configuration/packaging/routing/verification/recovery glue rather than creation of the underlying useful capability?

If WHITE_BOX_HARVEST is selected, has the target been reduced to residual learned behavior after JIT knowledge, deterministic substitutes, already-owned capabilities, and unnecessary neural scope are removed?
If WHITE_BOX_HARVEST is selected for promotion, do matched ablation/rescue, specificity, and held-out contamination controls support causal sufficiency rather than correlation?
If WHITE_BOX_HARVEST is selected for promotion, can the exact Brain route retain the target capability with the donor removed as target-capability provider?
If a harvested capsule depends on a base model or learned substrate, are all unavoidable runtime dependencies disclosed and counted rather than hidden behind an adapter?
If WHITE_BOX_HARVEST is selected, are exact donor provenance, hashes, license, derivative-use and redistribution constraints recorded fail-closed?
Are untouched qualification tasks excluded from donor selection, extraction, tuning, pruning, and minimization before final qualification?
Is there a current durable reasoning decision receipt preserving the objective, invariants, evidence, conclusion, rejected alternatives, uncertainty, and supersession conditions?
Was live highest-authority state refreshed immediately before planning/execution?
Is the action bound to current canonical generation/commit and fail-closed on drift?
Is the terminal objective and current causal frontier explicit?

Before any consequential current-blocker claim, recommendation, route selection, or execution decision, did the operator refresh live canonical state and complete current-base seven-layer OBS rather than relying on memory, summaries, or prior conclusions?
Does a generation-bound recursive OBS receipt cover the current task, capability, blocker, route and verifier?
Does recursive_obs.canonical_base_commit exactly equal the trusted PR base commit?

Does the receipt satisfy V6 structure, white-box harvesting semantics, live challenger-frontier requirements, and a current selected-route execution preflight with every required volatile dependency READY?
Was the local goal tested against the real useful outcome and unnecessary proxy goals deleted?
Were inherited and external existing capability routes searched before creating new capability machinery?
Was the blocker tested for deletion, bypass, substitution or irrelevance before repair?
Was DELETE->BYPASS->REUSE->SUBSTITUTE->WHITE_BOX_HARVEST->COMPOSE->CONFIGURE->INTEGRATE applied before composition/configuration/integration?
Was direct independent verification of the real effect preferred over new benchmark/gate machinery?
Will a successful capability acquisition trigger deletion/supersession of now-redundant queued work and a fresh reuse attempt?
Was the OBS/search process itself shortened, cached, reused or stopped where further analysis cannot change the route decision?
For externally satisfiable work, was the route universe refreshed within the allowed freshness lease immediately before this decision?
Is the exact selected route currently executable, with a preflight checked within 2 hours and every required dependency READY?
For each required volatile dependency, is readiness supported by a direct probe or independent verifier rather than historical success or generic public status alone?
For each account-, quota-, region-, or capacity-scoped dependency, is the evidence scoped to the exact execution context?
Did discovery span inherited Brain routes, official primary sources, code/package registries, broad web/community sources, and distinct capability/supplier/form/recency query families?
Was the incumbent explicitly challenged and are all plausible dominating alternatives resolved before expensive continuation?
Among correctness-sufficient routes, is the selected route currently the fastest to verified reusable output, then cheapest?
If this is supporting work, does one exact unresolved predicate block the selected real task and does OBS prove this support action is the fastest sufficient unblock?
Has the support action budget since the last real-output event not been exceeded?
Can this action be traced to reusable capability inheritance, verified real-task completion, fresh reuse, frontier dependency removal, or residual-gap localization?
Does the action avoid assumptions contradicted by live canonical state?
Were inherited capabilities, artifacts, prior tasks, connected tools, software and equivalent routes searched?
Was evidence state explicitly classified using canonical evidence-presence classes?
If capability is proven but proof is missing, is evidence recovery used instead of rerun?
For missing evidence, were higher recovery steps exhausted first?
Does recursive OBS prove any new infrastructure is strictly necessary on the fastest surviving route?
If freezing a hidden gate, were carrier, runtime contract, verifier, closure, orthogonality, and synthetic-gate necessity already proven without hidden payload?
Does verification close a material uncertainty that changes a capability decision?
If an adequate route exists, are we executing it rather than continuing search or platform work?
If user action is requested, is it the smallest genuine external authority boundary?
